author: Microsoft
description:
@alixearle visits Microsoft's headquarters for an inside tour of the Surface hardware lab, a trip inside the world's quietest room, and a firsthand look at how Microsoft products are designed. 
 
Sitting down with Microsoft Consumer CMO Yusuf Mehdi, Alix shares the story behind her viral skincare launch with Reale Actives, how creators can stay authentic while growing, and what it really takes to grow as a creator in the age of AI.
